Terms of use

Rucking Revolution provides information and tools for training, learning and planning.

Using the website

Use the website lawfully and respect other people’s rights. Do not attempt to disrupt the service, bypass access controls or misuse the material.

Assessment standards

The organisations running assessments set their own requirements. Check their current published rules, eligibility, equipment and scoring before preparing for or attending an assessment. The website does not administer those assessments.

Training and events

Rucking and demanding physical training involve risk. Choose workloads appropriate to your capacity, equipment and conditions. If you have concerns about your health or ability to train, seek appropriate professional advice. Stop or adapt a session when conditions or symptoms make it unsafe.

Availability and accuracy

We aim to provide useful and accurate information, but requirements, event details and other information may change. Check with the relevant organiser before relying on specific requirements or making arrangements.

Applicable law

These terms are subject to applicable Norwegian law. Nothing in them is intended to limit mandatory consumer or other statutory rights.

Contact

Questions about the website or its terms can be sent to info@ruckingrevolution.org.
